My recent public and academic engagement focuses on the social dimensions of emerging energy systems, particularly **hydrogen, ammonia, offshore renewables, climate risk and just transition**.

## Earlier engagement

Earlier presentations include work on energy and water policy preferences, disaster preparedness, China–Pakistan economic relations, women's political representation, governance and water/energy challenges. A complete chronological list is available in my downloadable CV.
